blocks.text: To add to Michelle Rose's note, the coverage review is now in reasonable shape. I have read the last two years of trade and financial press, together with the analyst commentary, and sorted it into a handful of recurring themes.

Two points are worth raising early, with the usual caution that a first read can still shift. The Gallegos, Pope and Marsh operational record is covered fairly and consistently, which is a real strength. The financial narrative, by contrast, is told less clearly, and where it is thin a few outlets fill the gap with framing of their own. Neither point is a conclusion yet; both are early reads that the interviews will test.

It would help to see the investor materials before I take this any further, so that I can set what {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} has said against how it has been received. I will hold the fuller write-up until those are to hand, Robert Smith. A day or two either way makes little difference; having the documents in front of me makes a great deal.
